# IsIterableCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.1" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `IsIterableCanBeUsedInspection`

`is_array($v) || $v instanceof Traversable` is exactly what `is_iterable($v)`
checks. On a language level where `is_iterable()` is available, the one call
is shorter and makes the intent obvious.

## Example

```php{3,4,5}
<?php
function walkAll($bag, $other) {
    $a = is_array($bag) || $bag instanceof \Traversable;
    $b = ($bag instanceof Traversable) || is_array($bag->items) || $bag->items instanceof Traversable;
    $c = $other === null || (is_array($other) || ($other instanceof \Traversable));

    $d = is_array($bag) || $other instanceof Traversable;           // different subject
    $e = (is_array($bag)) || $bag instanceof Traversable;           // call is parenthesised
    $f = is_array($bag) || $bag instanceof Iterator;              // other interface
    $g = is_array($bag) || ($bag instanceof Traversable && $other); // inside &&
    $h = is_array($bag) or $bag instanceof Traversable;             // keyword or
    $i = is_array($bag) && $x || $bag instanceof Traversable;       // direct parent is &&
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;is_iterable($bag)&#39; instead of the is_array()/instanceof Traversable pair.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;is_iterable($bag-&gt;items)&#39; instead of the is_array()/instanceof Traversable pair.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;is_iterable($other)&#39; instead of the is_array()/instanceof Traversable pair.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IsIterableCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IsIterableCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection IsIterableCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
